developer.title: Developer API
developer.intro: Use your SupDance account to quote, submit, and track generation from a server or script.
developer.keyHelp: One active key per account. Keep it server-side. Submitting a task uses your account credits.
developer.exampleSetup: Set SUPDANCE_API_KEY, SUPDANCE_MODEL_ID, SUPDANCE_MAX_CREDITS, and SUPDANCE_REQUEST_ID. Choose an active model and use the same unique request ID when retrying the same submission.
developer.authHeader: Send this header with every API request.
developer.models: List active models and their capabilities.
developer.quote: Get a price for a model and its exact inputs. The quote expires after five minutes.
developer.submit: Submit the quoted task using the same model and inputs. Both POST requests require an Idempotency-Key.
developer.poll: Read task status, credits, and the result when available.
developer.download: Download the stored result for a completed task.
developer.readError: Could not read the API key status. Try refreshing.
developer.keyChanged: The key or account changed. Refresh before trying again.
developer.writeError: The request did not finish. Refresh key status before retrying.
developer.copyError: Clipboard access failed. Select the text and copy it manually.
developer.invalidate: This immediately invalidates the current key. Scripts using it will need a new key.
developer.reveal: The full key is shown only now. Copy it before closing this view.

subscriptionFaq.title: Subscription and credits FAQ
subscriptionFaq.empty: No questions have been published yet.
subscriptionFaq.pricingQuotaQuestion: How do subscription credits differ from universal credits?
subscriptionFaq.pricingQuotaAnswer: Subscriptions include credits issued monthly. One-time credit packs go into your permanent credit balance. Your wallet shows the order credits are used.
subscriptionFaq.pricingPaymentQuestion: Which billing cycles and payment methods are available?
subscriptionFaq.pricingPaymentAnswer: Monthly is the available billing cycle. Quarterly and annual purchases are unavailable. Checkout shows only payment methods the server confirms are available.
subscriptionFaq.pricingDeliveryQuestion: When are credits issued after payment?
subscriptionFaq.pricingDeliveryAnswer: New purchases are currently paused. Existing orders continue to be processed according to their payment status.

billing.faq1Q: What is the difference between subscription credits and one-time credits?
billing.faq1A: Subscription credits reset each billing cycle. One-time credits never expire and roll over indefinitely.
billing.faq2Q: What payment cycles and methods are supported?
